reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text:
Lo he estado usando como parte de mi rutina después de limpiar el rostro en la mañana. 
La textura es bastante ligera, casi acuosa, y se absorbe rápido en la piel. Me gusta aplicarlo directamente con las manos dando pequeños toques. Deja la piel fresca y preparada para los siguientes pasos de la rutina, como el sérum o la crema hidratante.
Algo que me gustó es que ayuda a que la piel se sienta más suave con el uso constante. Esto probablemente se debe a que la fórmula combina centella asiática para calmar la piel, ácido hialurónico para hidratar y AHA/LHA para una exfoliación suave, que ayudan a mejorar la textura y eliminar células muertas gradualmente.
No se siente pesado ni pegajoso, por lo que funciona bien tanto en la rutina de mañana como de noche. También es fácil de combinar con otros productos sin que haga pilling.
En general, me parece un buen tónico si buscas algo ligero que ayude a hidratar, calmar la piel y mejorar ligeramente la textura con el tiempo.
reviews.zh: 我一直將佢加入我嘅日常護膚流程，喺朝早洗面之後用。質地好輕盈，幾乎係水狀，而且好快就俾皮膚吸收。我鍾意直接用手指輕輕拍上皮膚。搽完之後皮膚感覺清爽，亦幫皮膚做好準備迎接之後嘅護膚步驟，例如精華或保濕面霜。我鍾意嘅一點係持續使用之後皮膚摸落會更加滑。原因可能係配方結合咗積雪草舒緩皮膚、透明質酸保濕、仲有 AHA/LHA 溫和去角質，幫助改善膚質同逐步去除老廢角質。質感唔會厚重亦唔會黏笠，所以無論係朝早定夜晚嘅流程都好啱用。亦都好容易同其他產品一齊用，唔會搓泥。整體嚟講，如果你想搵一款輕盈、有保濕同舒緩效果、仲可以慢慢改善膚質嘅爽膚水，呢款係唔錯嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: Before purchasing this product, I used Anya but didn’t helped me so much but this one does help!! My skin is oily and helps to soothes my sensitive skin when comes to the winter rn
reviews.zh: 買呢隻產品之前我用過 Anya，但對我嚟講幫助唔大，反而呢隻真係有用！！我係油性肌，而家冬天嗰陣可以幫到我舒緩敏感肌。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: Fourth purchase. THIS IS AMAZING. it leaves your skin feeling hydrated and tight and it does help even out your skin. I would definitely repurchase this EVERY SINGLE TIME.
reviews.zh: 已經係第四次回購。呢隻真係超正。搽完皮膚感覺保濕又緊緻，而且真係有幫助均勻膚色。我一定會次次回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: The formula is great and hydrating. But it has a flower perfume type of scent that lingers and irritates my sensitive skin. I'll be giving this to a friend.
reviews.zh: 配方唔錯而且保濕效果好。但有一種花香類香水味殘留好耐，仲刺激到我嘅敏感肌。我會送俾朋友用。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: slightly stings (?) but refreshing! i use it as a wiping toner with a cotton pad to help even out my skin tone. if you have sensitive skin, i’d recommend incorporating it slowly and following up with gentler products
reviews.zh: 有少少刺刺嘅感覺（？）不過好清爽！我會用化妝棉當抹拭式爽膚水咁用，幫助均勻膚色。如果係敏感肌嘅話，建議慢慢加入護膚流程，再用溫和嘅產品跟住。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text:
このブランドさんの日焼け止めがめちゃくちゃ好きで、今回ピーリング系探してて迷わずここで買いました！
そしてやっぱり良い！！
元々肌が弱いわけではないけれど、なんとなく連続では使わないようにしてますが、今のところヒリつきもなくツルツルになるし、案外保湿性も高くて満足です。
匂い、テクスチャー、容器が全て文句ないし、パッケージも大好きな水色で使うたび可愛い気分になれます♪
reviews.zh:
我一直好鍾意呢個品牌嘅防曬，今次想搵去角質類嘅產品就毫不猶豫喺度買咗！
結果真係冇揀錯！！
雖然我本身皮膚唔算特別敏感，不過都會盡量避免連續用，但而家用緊完全冇刺痛感，皮膚變得滑溜，保濕效果仲意外地好好，好滿意。
氣味、質地、容器全部都無可挑剔，包裝都係我最鍾意嘅水藍色，每次用都覺得好靚心情都靚晒♪

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: My skin can be very sensitive, but this worked so well for me! I was really missing a chemical exfoliation step in my routine and this was the perfect product. I don't know if I've noticed any brightening to be honest, but it has helped clean my pores and hydrate my skin. I think the only thing I wanted from this product was more moisture? It could just be the type of moisturizing ingredients but my skin can feel a little rough after this toner.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚有時會好敏感，但呢隻對我嚟講真係超啱用！我一直好想喺護膚流程加入化學去角質嘅步驟，呢隻就啱啱好係我想要嘅產品。老實講我唔知有冇見到提亮效果，但佢有幫助清潔毛孔同保濕皮膚。我覺得我對呢款產品唯一嘅要求係再多啲保濕力？可能只係保濕成分嘅問題，用完呢隻爽膚水之後皮膚有少少粗糙嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Brightening Toner 210mL
reviews.text: I first tried this when I got the full bottle as a bonus gift from olive young event. During summer it didn't feel very special but as the heater weather rolls in, I find it very helpful hydrating my skin. I have combination skin and it makes my skin glow without any cream or essence/serum. Great for skin pack as well. I like it more than many bifida toner, which isn't really hydrating for me. If I were to be critical and have to be picky, the only downside of it is that it stings if I get it in my eye a bit ( I use skin pack around my eyes with it ). Other than that it's amazing and that's why I came back to purchase it.
reviews.zh: 第一次用係喺 Olive Young 活動攞到正裝贈品嗰陣。夏天用嗰陣覺得冇乜特別，但冬天開暖氣嘅時候就覺得佢好有助保濕。我係混合性肌，用完之後皮膚有水光感，唔使額外搽面霜或者精華。當面膜用亦都好正。比起好多 bifida 爽膚水我都更加鍾意呢隻，因為其他 bifida 爽膚水對我嚟講唔算真係保濕。如果要挑剔嘅話，唯一嘅缺點就係如果少少掂到眼睛會有刺痛感（我會用佢做眼周面膜）。除此之外佢真係好正，所以我就回購咗。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
